newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 7-month coconut exports down 40.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 7-month coconut exports down 40.8 pct.

text.p: Philippine coconut exports fell by 40.8 percent to 855,046 tonnes in the first seven months of the year from the year-ago level of 1,443,570 tonnes, the government Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) said on Friday.
Total FOB value of coconut exports dropped by 23.2 percent to $490.72 million for the first seven months from $638.98 million in the same period last year, the PCA said.
Lower coconut exports were due to a 41.6 percent decline in coconut oil exports from January to July at 480,341 tonnes from 823,021 tonnes last year.
Copra exports also fell by 86.2 percent for the first seven months of the year to 3,076 tonnes from the year-ago level of 22,302 tonnes.
For the month of July, coconut exports dropped by 30.4 percent to 109,175 tonnes from 156,958 tonnes in July 1995.
